description:
Listen to Osho in English and Hindi, with 5,481 discourses across 351 series. Download a talk for a walk or a quiet evening, read along with its transcript, and continue from your saved position next time. Every feature is free.

READ AS YOU LISTEN
Original-language transcripts are available for 4,946 discourses. Follow highlighted text, search for a passage, change the text size, or tap a sentence to play from that point. Copy or share one passage or several, or pick out exact words. The reader remembers your place, and Audio is here lets you correct timing when needed.

LISTEN IN TRANSLATION
Hear an English talk in Hindi, a Hindi talk in English, or either in another language. Apple Translation translates the transcript on your device, and a system voice reads it at Osho's pace. Play the finished part while the rest translates, or switch to the original recording at the same moment. Machine translation may not be perfect.

FIND YOUR NEXT DISCOURSE
Explore Zen, Tantra, Tao, Upanishads, Yoga and more. Search by series name or topic, filter by language, or start with Popular and Beginner Friendly collections.

LISTEN OFFLINE
Download talks by series and see how much storage they use. Background downloads continue when you switch apps or lock the screen. Optional Smart Download prepares the next discourse, while Smart Delete can clear finished recordings.

ADJUST THE SOUND
DeNoise brings recording cleanup, volume boost and quiet-speech controls together. Choose Best Quality, Balanced or Gentle Cleanup and compare with the original sound. Results vary by recording.

SAVE A MOMENT
Add timestamped bookmarks with notes and categories, then return directly to a passage. Listening stats show daily totals, streaks and completed discourses. Set a sleep timer for a countdown or the end of a talk.

MADE FOR EVERYDAY LISTENING
- Background playback with Lock Screen, Control Center and AirPods controls
- Playback speed from 0.5x to 2x in fine steps such as 0.85x, with quick back and forward controls
- AirPlay for compatible speakers and devices
- Progress, bookmarks, listening stats and transcript reading state synced through your own iCloud account
- Light, dark or system appearance and eight accent colors
- Downloaded recordings accessible in the iOS Files app

MORE WAYS TO LISTEN
- Apple Watch: control the iPhone player and browse your downloads from your wrist. Save a talk to the Watch and listen with Bluetooth headphones, even without your iPhone. Your place is sent back to the iPhone.
- iPad: a sidebar, the transcript beside the player, keyboard shortcuts and more than one window.
- CarPlay: pick up Continue Listening, your downloads and bookmarks in the car, with speed and bookmark buttons on the Now Playing screen.

No app account is required. There are no ads or tracking. Optional one-time tips and auto-renewing yearly support through Apple help fund development. Neither unlocks features or content; every feature stays free. Manage or cancel yearly support in your App Store account.
